title: Night queue: studies that run while the laptop is left alone
claude_budget_note: Claude Code calls one night may use (14 Nov, first guess: rules-author ~110 + study-15a ~500 + room for study-10's strong cells). Each job's claude_calls is a rough estimate for one night; the morning report shows the real count, so tune both from there.
paused_note: 14 Nov 2026: Carlo paused every experiment (only The Motion goes on, and it does not run from this queue). Every job is off; state.json keeps what each one finished, so setting a job's "enabled" back to true resumes it. The night then writes "Coda in pausa" in the morning report and stops. 20 Nov: influence-actions turned on (Carlo 'ok go'), the only exception. 20 Nov: alphaxiv-judges on too (Carlo 'si vai'), short, no Claude calls. 21 Nov: coding-choices on (study 17 phase 1, Carlo 'Ok').

jobs.name: alphaxiv-judges
jobs.note: Study C observational pilot (Carlo 'si vai' 20 Nov): DeepSeek + Qwen label 40 critique -> reply pairs from the public alphaXiv agent archive. ~80 OpenRouter calls, pence. Runs before influence-actions; summary in the job's last lines.

jobs.name: influence-actions
jobs.note: Influence in actions, phase A (Carlo 'ok go' 20 Nov; design room/influence-actions-design.md): Claude, Gemini, Codex drive two small tasks (checkable claim: a surcharge rate; unverifiable claim: banker's rounding) under four arms (scripted peer, ticket, no claim, real peer), 3 repeats, 90 sessions, 3 at a time. Judges DeepSeek + Qwen. ~£6 Gemini, ~240 Claude calls. The only job on while the rest of the queue stays paused; resumes with the same --out if the night ends first.

jobs.name: influence-round-2
cmd: while pgrep -f "[m]otion-lab[.]js" >/dev/null; do sleep 60; done; exec node influence.js examples/influence/rates-2.json examples/influence/rounding-2.json --out=$HOME/.agent-dispatch/influence/round-2
jobs.note: Influence in actions, round 2 (Carlo 'ok' 21 Nov 07:07; preregistered in lab/influence-plan.md): same 90-session plan, OPEN turns save no code (the file is seen before any code), and the rounding claim now goes against a visible test. Waits while a motion-lab.js run is going (same Claude/Gemini/Codex quotas). ~£2-4 Gemini, ~200 Claude calls.

jobs.name: influence-incident
cmd: while pgrep -f "[m]otion-lab[.]js" >/dev/null; do sleep 60; done; exec node influence.js examples/influence/incident.json --out=$HOME/.agent-dispatch/influence/incident --push
jobs.note: Influence in actions, task 3 (Carlo 'ok' 22 Nov; preregistered in lab/influence-plan.md row 16): incident investigation. The driver names the root cause of a payments outage from logs, metrics and deploys; the claim blames a decoy deploy that went out just before the errors. Claude, Gemini and Codex, arms S/T/N/P, 3 repeats (45 sessions). ~£1-2 Gemini + judges, ~120 Claude calls. Waits for motion-lab; --push sends the summary to night-reports influence/incident/. Rounds 1-2 (influence-actions, influence-round-2) are finished and now off. OFF 23 Nov (Carlo: experiments stop here). Turn on again for one Gemini recovery night after ~28 Nov, when the Gemini quota is back; it resumes with the same --out.

jobs.name: coding-choices
cmd: while pgrep -f "[m]otion-lab[.]js" >/dev/null; do sleep 60; done; exec node codechoice.js examples/codechoice/study-17.json --out=$HOME/.agent-dispatch/codechoice/study-17
jobs.note: Study 17 phase 1, the choice bench (Carlo 'Ok' 21 Nov 10:02, and 'la possiamo fare oggi' 10:08; preregistered in lab/influence-plan.md row 17): Claude, Gemini and Codex each build 3 features of a small notes service 4 times (36 builds, hidden tests score them), then choose between pairs blind / with true authors / two of their own / with tech lead-junior roles (198 choices); DeepSeek + Qwen judge every pair blind (~216 calls). ~£8-10 (Gemini + OpenRouter), ~110 Claude calls. Runs after influence-round-2; resumes with the same --out if the night ends first. OFF 23 Nov (Carlo: experiments stop here). Turn on again for one Gemini recovery night after ~28 Nov, when the Gemini quota is back; it resumes with the same --out.

jobs.name: study15-phase0-qwen-2
jobs.note: Study 15 phase 0, second run (Carlo OK 13 Nov 19:46): tolerant answer parsing, 2048 tokens, new claim task (partner states clues: true / false nobody could notice / false that clashes with one's own). Qwen3-8B, 200 puzzles, Modal L40S, stops by itself, ~$1-2 (at most ~$6). Run 1 was by hand on 13 Nov. Outcome in night-reports study15/latest.md. A new run needs a new name.

jobs.name: rules-author
jobs.note: Who wrote the rules? (The Trap): Gemini words the rules, then 3 episodes per rulebook with Claude, Gemini, Codex, and Claude + Codex judge the puzzles blind (~£1-2 Gemini, 2-3 h; Carlo OK 13 Nov). Picks up where it stopped (Gemini's rules already written 14 Nov). Moved before study-15a (coordinator, 14 Nov): it is smaller (~110 Claude calls) and sure to finish, while 15a would use up the limit; on 14 Nov it started at 01:36 after the organise/kata reruns and Claude had hit its 5-hour limit; outcome in night-reports rules-author/latest.md

jobs.name: study-15a
jobs.note: Officina (study 15a): chat vs versions+plan-first vs the Officina vs Officina without private first/check; Claude+Claude, 2 poems (one with rules split between the two), 3 repeats — moved to the front on 14 Nov: on 13-14 Nov it ran at 01:37, after the other Claude jobs, and 108/144 calls failed (likely usage limit). ~£0.30-0.60 Gemini judge

jobs.name: diamond-pilot
jobs.note: Study 16 pilot, double diamond on the elevator task (Carlo chose the task and approved the cost 21 Nov; preregistered in lab/influence-plan.md row 16): one instance, six arms (D-drafts added 21 Nov), ~42 calls each. ~170 Claude calls, ~45-50 Gemini calls with code (~£3-5, estimate), Codex in the subscription, DeepSeek + Qwen family judges (pence). Off until the first free night after the weekend (Tue 24 or Wed 25 Nov); resumes with the same --out.

Needs llama.cpp once: sh ~/agents-wrapper/scripts/install-llamacpp.sh (exit 2 until then, then it runs the next night)

jobs.name: study-10
jobs.note: Swarm, full run (study 10, local, £0; solo-strong uses Claude on the subscription). ~8k calls over several nights, keeps finished cells; repeats of a model Ollama lacks are skipped (pull gemma3:12b). Stops with exit 3 after 4 failed calls in a row (model not answering), and cells with more than 5% failed calls run again. Last in the queue: it fills whatever is left of the night (~10 nights at ~35 s a call), so the short jobs before it run first
